others.name: NUSCALE POWER Corp
others.q: WHEREAS, NuScale has insufficient funds to continue its on-going business operations and, as a result, Fluor has elected to invest significant funds in NuScale at a critical time (the "Investment");

own.name: NuScale
own.q: Revenue for 2024 was $16.3 billion and net income attributable to Fluor was $2.1 billion, or $12.30 per diluted share, reflecting the deconsolidation and subsequent remeasurement of Fluor’s investment in NuScale.
